newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, but tone less firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, but tone less firm.

text.p: NWE gasoline remains tight for prompt material but looks better supplied from mid August onwards.
Eurograde barges were talked around $203.00 while August swaps were a touch under $200.
Shakier NYMEX gasoline which could come under renewed pressure from talk of bearish API data that will be released later today.
"API numbers due later today are suggesting unfriendly gasoline data," said one analyst.
Dealers said physical demand was only moderate and that prices were not expected to fluctuate greatly ahead of the API data is released after the market close.
